raw.text: Recording of frequent structural damage to the hull of bulk carriers (some of it serious) motivates the need to optimize
the concept of computer-based rational design through advanced analysis methods.
The general objective of this paper is to optimize the midship section through structural modelling under combined bending stress
with transverse-vertical bending and longitudinal torsion.
It is important to highlight, from the beginning, the work's originality and contributions.
a) Reformulation of the structural modeling of the hull.
